name: Interval timer
description: Fitness intervals: WORK and REST phases for a number of rounds, with the round, the time left and a phase colour; shows Done at the end.

params.name: work
params.help: Work time per round (seconds or m:ss)

params.name: rest
params.help: Rest time between rounds (seconds or m:ss; 0: none)

params.name: label
params.help: Small line at the top, e.g. the workout's name (empty: none)

params.name: done_text
params.help: Shown when all rounds are over
